items.name: Corn on the cob (2 short cut rounds, kernels only)
items.fdc_query: Corn, sweet, yellow, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
items.preparation: Boiled or steamed corn cob cut into two short rounds, standing on end; no visible butter, oil or seasoning

fdc.description: Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels on cob, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

rows: Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels cut off cob, boiled, drained, without salt

scale_cues: White square plate assumed to be about 20-25 cm across; each cob round is about 5 cm in diameter relative to the plate. The overhead view hides the height of the rounds, assumed to be about 2.5-4 cm each.
assumptions: Grams are edible kernel mass only; the inedible cob core is excluded (total with cob would be about 80-120 g).
Height of each round cannot be seen from overhead; assumed about 3 cm, giving roughly 20 g of kernels per piece.
Corn is assumed cooked (boiled or steamed) and plain; no butter, oil or sauce is visible on the corn or plate.
